name: widgets-v1

readers.android: app/src/main/java/it/binario/app/widget/ (WidgetSettings.kt, WidgetTrainTypes.kt, WidgetPresentation.kt, RouteWidgetTimeline.kt, StationWidgetModel.kt, TrainsWidgetModel.kt, WidgetAutoRefresh.kt)

description: The three home-screen widgets (Tratta, Tabellone stazione, I miei treni) on both phones: the automatic refresh (intervals, days, one or two daily windows, also across midnight), the automatic return direction, the train type groups a widget can hide and the codes that tell them, which runs a widget lists and for how long, when its live values count as fresh, which favourite trains a refresh asks for, and the retries of a refresh the user asked for. Times are railway-local (Europe/Rome).

timeRanges.note: What the source returns now: the list of the widgets added before the settings.
Until 23:59 of the day, kept for the day and readable offline.
